name: hotspot3D
description: HotSpot3D: 3-D chip thermal simulation, 7-point explicit FD stencil over nx×ny×nz grid.

output_parser.comment: Each line is '<index>\t<value>'; float temperature in °C, compared with tolerance.

tolerance.comment: Well-conditioned float32 stencil; --fmad=false ports are bit-exact. Tolerance covers GPU reordering.

build.comment: Correctness build uses --fmad=false to match CPU serial float32 order.
